label_freeze_note: Public synthetic labels fixed before any run. No private text. Filler skills are generated deterministically to reach catalog_size.

skills.name: himalaya
skills.description: Read, search, and send email over IMAP and SMTP from the terminal.
skills.excerpt: Use himalaya envelope list to read mail. Use himalaya message send to reply. Never print passwords.

skills.name: mcporter
skills.description: List, authenticate, and call MCP servers and their tools from the terminal.
skills.excerpt: Run mcporter list to discover servers. Run mcporter call server.tool with JSON arguments.

skills.name: songsee
skills.description: Render audio spectrograms and features such as mel, chroma, and MFCC from sound files.
skills.excerpt: songsee input.wav --mel writes a spectrogram image. Use --chroma for pitch class features.

skills.name: qmd
skills.description: Hybrid local search over markdown notes, documents, and meeting transcripts.
skills.excerpt: qmd query runs keyword and vector search over indexed notes and transcripts.

skills.name: herdr
skills.description: Control terminal workspaces and panes that run coding agents.
skills.excerpt: herdr pane list shows panes. herdr send delivers keystrokes to a coding agent pane.

skills.name: openhue
skills.description: Control Philips Hue lights, scenes, and rooms through the OpenHue CLI.
skills.excerpt: openhue set light kitchen --on --brightness 60 changes a light. Scenes use openhue set scene.

skills.name: blogwatcher
skills.description: Monitor blogs and RSS or Atom feeds and report new posts.
skills.excerpt: blogwatcher add URL subscribes to a feed. blogwatcher scan reports new articles.

skills.name: nano-pdf
skills.description: Edit text inside existing PDF files with natural language instructions.
skills.excerpt: nano-pdf edit file.pdf applies a text edit to a PDF page and keeps layout.

skills.name: guidance
skills.description: Constrain language model output with grammars so generated JSON is always valid.
skills.excerpt: Define a grammar, then generate. The output matches the JSON schema by construction.

skills.name: obliteratus
skills.description: Remove refusal behavior from open model weights through weight surgery.
skills.excerpt: Load weights, locate the refusal direction, project it out, and save the edited model.

skills.name: docker-management
skills.description: Operate Docker containers, images, volumes, and Compose stacks with health checks.
skills.excerpt: docker compose ps shows service health. Recreate one service with docker compose up -d service.

skills.name: kubernetes-patterns
skills.description: Write or debug Kubernetes manifests, rollouts, services, and resource limits.
skills.excerpt: kubectl rollout status deployment/name checks a rollout. Set requests and limits on each container.

skills.name: postgres-patterns
skills.description: Design and tune PostgreSQL schemas, queries, indexes, and migrations.
skills.excerpt: Use EXPLAIN ANALYZE to find slow queries. Add indexes with CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY.

skills.name: git-change-preparation
skills.description: Prepare signed Git commits and verify author, committer, and signer identity.
skills.excerpt: git commit -S signs a commit. git log --show-signature verifies the signer.

skills.name: pixel-art
skills.description: Create pixel art sprites with retro console color palettes.
skills.excerpt: Pick an NES or Game Boy palette, draw on a small grid, then scale with nearest neighbor.

skills.name: maps
skills.description: Geocode addresses, find points of interest, and plan routes with OpenStreetMap.
skills.excerpt: Geocode with Nominatim. Route with OSRM between two coordinates.

skills.name: docker-art-gallery
skills.description: Curate a gallery of paintings about ships and harbors for a museum page.
skills.excerpt: Collect public domain harbor paintings, write captions, and lay out a gallery page.

skills.name: email-signature-designer
skills.description: Design HTML signature blocks with logos and brand colors.
skills.excerpt: Build a table based signature layout. Keep the logo under 20 KB.

skills.name: postgres-poster-printing
skills.description: Print large format posters and banners for events.
skills.excerpt: Export at 300 dpi with bleed. Send the file to a large format print shop.
